column1: # ROUTE -> PROFILE MATRIX (versioned, reviewed by hand). One row per route served by SERVER_PROFILE=combined.
# Gate: RouteProfileGateTest (every combined route exactly once, no stale rows; routes mounted per profile == rows of the profile's classes).
# Columns (TAB-separated): METHOD, PATH (params normalised to {}), PROFILE, AUTH, PURPOSE, CLIENT_CONSUMER
# PROFILE in {BOT, CONTROL, SHARED, AUTH, INTERNAL, HEALTH, METRICS}. Mounting: bot = BOT+SHARED+AUTH+HEALTH+METRICS;
#   control = CONTROL+SHARED+HEALTH+METRICS; combined = all (incl. INTERNAL, dev-only). 'consumer' (legacy minimal) is NOT derived from this file.
# AUTH in {none, user-jwt, admin, static-token-optional}. CLIENT_CONSUMER in {OposiBot, OposiControl, none}.
# Classification is explicit per row, never inferred from the URL prefix: e.g. /tags, /search, /search/reindex, /dashboard/metrics are CONTROL
# although they live outside /admin; /api/v1/app/legal/documents is BOT (shares canonicalProfileRoutes with AUTH, needs the auth runtime).
